ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Centrally concentrated high-intensity white region bounded by low-intensity pixels at the lateral tip and medial peduncle. Right lobe: Dominant high-intensity white region containing a distinct low-intensity vertical line in the superior quadrant and a mottled dark cluster in the inferior-lateral quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 95 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, medium-frequency serrations along the trailing boundary, displaying increased pixel-level irregularity at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, with the right lobe exhibiting a more pronounced arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A cluster of low-intensity pixels forming a mottled dark patch in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A sharp, low-intensity vertical linear feature approximately 45 pixels long in the upper-right quadrant, disrupting the contiguous high-intensity pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear mark (rake mark) on the right lobe and dark circular scarring/mottling on the lower-right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique dark 'ring-like' mottled cluster in the lower-right section of the fluke pigmentation.
